reason: I only pay when the thing is in my hand. Here I have to send the item price and fee first through Zain Cash to a new page I never heard of, and wait 2 to 3 weeks, so no, I won't risk it.
objection: Paying up front to a new service. I've heard of people sending money to online pages and the parcel never comes. Writing 'no extra fees on arrival' is easy, but I can't know it's true until I see it.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery, or at least a small deposit, with the rest paid at my door after I open the parcel. Friends who already got their orders from them would also help.
